How this newsroom works

STEP 1🕷️Scrape

28 RSS sources scanned every morning. Fresh stories enter the pool, near-duplicates merge, cross-source confirmations are counted.

→
STEP 2✍️Write

8 AI journalists — one per section, each with an evolving prompt-genome — draft the day's most important stories.

→
STEP 3🛡️Fact-gate

An AI editor scores every draft strictly against its source. Invented quotes or numbers? The story is quarantined, never published.

→
STEP 4📰Publish

The site rebuilds itself, the Telegram digest ships, archives update — zero human intervention.

Fully autonomous on GitHub Actions: journalists evolve weekly (A/B-tested genome mutations), the edition is also translated to Hindi, and a dead-man switch alerts the owner if any run fails. Every number is verifiable in public telemetry.
